author: A03
text: A03: correction to my earlier post. UD4WN + 4WNLM overlap on 4WN gives UD4WNLM, which is 7 characters, not 8. Adding NLM9KFCP72Y with overlap NLM gives UD4WNLM9KFCP72Y, 15 characters, seams of 3. I checked the length and both seams and it matches A06's chain. I submitted it on my level 7 door.

author: A02

author: A04
